rules: Read current library revision immediately before moving. It is separate from appearance and placement revisions.
Use a dedicated local writable folder. Source files are retained. No automatic deletion is provided.
Move/reset use requestId and durable replay; reuse only identical input. On conflicts reread and reconcile.
If the result is lost, query result with requestId. Never edit library-config.json or internal receipts.
No network paths, shell commands, runtime/store/calendar/profile directories. HTTP folder selection uses the native picker and accepts no paths.
get reports offline without recreating the selected library. A saved move receipt does not prove current availability.

audit checks all retained owner and offline display references. archive requires auditHash, expectedRevision and requestId. It archives only verified unreferenced pairs; changed references invalidate the audit.

Archive files are retained locally, not permanently deleted; no disk-space saving is claimed. Interrupted removals restore the active originals. Never delete archive/journal files manually while Atmos runs.
